scope.roots: Worker assembly seeds plus every non-wildcard runtime export of each workspace package materialized by the web profile roster and declared config-tree roster inputs.
scope.meaning: A conservative pack-time module-request closure, not the configured Cordis activation graph, eager module-evaluation trace, or proof that a conditional branch executes.
scope.requestKinds: module records import, re-export, supported literal dynamic import/require, and recognized createRequire requests; meta-resolve records import.meta.resolve URL mapping requests.

interpretation: image-module means the request resolves to a module included in the packed Worker image; it does not establish that every exported API is supported.
implemented-builtin-module means the proxy path is under the runtime implemented directory; member-level Node compatibility still requires behavioral tests.
structural-builtin-stub and external-replacement identify runtime substitutes, not equivalent host behavior.
unresolved external and meta-resolve requests remain explicit; they can fail if an execution path reaches them.

the graph roots include every materialized workspace package runtime export, including exports not activated by the composed web profile; it is a conservative packaging closure, not a profile boot trace.
the graph covers packer-recognized requests, not computed runtime specifiers, all conditional branches, or dynamic execution reachability.
